keyFindings.finding: 197 generated files across six runtimes; each names its owning generator; hook-registry.json is the single edit point for the four hook registration files.
Five hand-authored MCP/server registrations hardcode .opencode/bin/mcp-code-mode-launcher.cjs; .cursor/mcp.json is a real file though its manifest says symlink.
The Hermes repo-guards plugin hardcodes ten .opencode path constants that shell out to hook cores.
Home-level surface: 7 absolute git-hook symlinks (blocker), codex hooks/trust, hermes launcher, zsh aliases, pi trust/doc; repo-symlinked configs follow the repo.
